summary: Changes from v1: (1) WP3 route taxonomy — the Rung-S route is now counted on the ENGINE-HOSTED side of the ledger (route kind 'diffractive_engine_hosted', extending analytics_engine_hosted semantics) so the 7b census still sees every Rung-S draw as engine demand; only the Rung-P route carries an analytic-side label ('diffractive_analytic'). (2) Closure #2 wording downgraded from 'covers/closes the saddle demand' to 'the saddle far-field low-w band is formally HOSTED with a first-class certificate (refusals eliminated); it remains CHART DEMAND for the campaign', with an explicit hand-off note that the campaign's saddle-bottom charts should store the residual against the exact anchor F(w->0) = -1j*sqrt(mu_macro) (the optimal-representation clause in todo.d/lensing_born_farfield_completion.md). (3) WP3 reports Rung-S coverage as an 'engine-hosted-with-certificate fraction', reported SEPARATELY from Rung-P's genuinely-analytic fraction, because the tiling design consumes the two numbers differently. No other changes: the R1 anchor correction, the two-rung structure, R2's divergence ruling, the certificate forms, and the test set all stand. --- Build: low-w diffractive analytic rung — serve the wave-optics amplification F(w) band bottom that today either invokes the exact engine or refuses (the F070 far-field w-floor fall-through). CRITICAL CORRECTION to the handoff premise (Professor R1): the low-w anchor is F(w->0) = sqrt(mu_macro)*exp(-i*pi*n/2), NOT 1 — F->1 holds ONLY at gamma=kappa=0. Positive parity (det A>0, n=0) -> +sqrt(mu_macro); macro saddle (det A<0, n=1) -> -1j*sqrt(mu_macro) (F009-S). The parity wall is a branch point, so there are TWO rungs, never unified (Professor R2): (Rung P) positive parity (reduced shear gamma'<1) has a genuinely analytic reduced-shear closed form G_PM (from _hyp1f1.point_mass_g_derivatives) plus a convergent shear-operator series, admitted by a leading-omitted-term truncation certificate w_low = (gamma'/2)*[sqrt(mu_macro)*R_{M+1}/bar]^(1/(M+1)) with bar=CERTIFICATION_BAR=1e-4 (no measured constants), self-refusing as gamma'->1 via DELTA_GAMMA_P; the w*ln(w) phase is carried EXACTLY in C(w) and is never certificate-bounded. (Rung S) the macro saddle series DIVERGES (Fermat-delay moments diverge at every order), so there is no analytic series certificate at any order; instead HOST the exact 1D Schwinger integral f_schwinger directly as a band-split host, self-certifying via paired N/2N quadrature error (tol 3e-10, a first-class certificate), with per-draw upper reachability W_reach = min(w_split, ~60) — never hard-coded. Rung S is an ENGINE-HOSTED interim (a strict improvement over the F070 refusal), NOT a closure of the 12.67% saddle demand under the 7b zero-engine-served bar; it stays chart demand for the campaign. This addresses all three owner closures: #1 the F070 astroid far-exterior diffractive sliver (Rung P, genuinely analytic closure), #2 the saddle far-field low-w band formally hosted with a certificate — refusals eliminated, chart demand retained (Rung S), #3 shrinking every c3/Born band-split's below-split engine host to [w_low, w_split] (Rung P for positive/Born splits; Rung S engine-hosted for the 1409 saddle_c3 splits). Escalate-not-iterate: if Rung P truncation misses the engine reference anywhere the certificate admits, STOP — do not widen bars. Scope EXCLUDES deltoid coordinate redesign, tube trims, tiling/training campaigns, 2b arm-extension, ceiling-constant raises, and diffractive-bottom CHART training. WP1 adds the Rung-P analytic module; WP2 wires both rungs at the F070 site (nested band-split via two sequential _band_split_mask calls; _engine_envelope_below_split reused unchanged; serve via FARFIELD_DIFFRACTIVE demodulated by geom.t_min) and fixes the FARFIELD_DIFFRACTIVE 'F->1' doc bug; WP3 re-gates the engine-free serve_route_census and runs the in-build 10k (seed 0) re-census (Fact 7: the c3 build shipped a stale classifier). Tests are authored by the Test Developer from domain_test_descriptions; doc/spec_changelog fragments are the post-WP doc-sync phase, not a WP.

AUDIT it against the spec below (values, certificate closed form, self-refusal, no import cycle) and fix only real defects; do not rewrite. Import point_mass_g_derivatives and prefactor_c from _hyp1f1 (call _hyp1f1, NOT _born, so this module does not force a _born->_hyp1f1 import cycle). (1) Reduced shear gamma' = gamma/(1-kappa); self-refuse (raise a named DiffractiveDomainError, mirroring BornDomainError) when gamma' >= 1 - DELTA_GAMMA_P (the parity wall) — positive parity ONLY lives here. (2) Build F_P(w) = C(w) * G_PM(w,s) + sum_{k=1..M} operator-series terms in (i*gamma'/2w), where C(w)=prefactor_c(...) carries the exact w*ln(w) phase (NEVER bound this phase by the certificate) and G_PM comes from point_mass_g_derivatives. (3) LOW-W ANCHOR (load-bearing correction): as w->0, F_P -> sqrt(mu_macro) (n=0 Morse for positive parity), NOT 1. Assert this limit only holds generally; F->1 is the gamma=kappa=0 special case only. (4) Certificate: expose diffractive_w_low(matrix/geometry, M) returning w_low = (gamma'/2) * [ sqrt(mu_macro) * R_{M+1} / bar ]^(1/(M+1)), where R_{M+1} is the geometry-only magnitude of the first omitted operator-tail term measured from point_mass_g_derivatives, bar = CERTIFICATION_BAR (optionally divided by a SAFETY factor of 20 if you follow the c3 precedent — match whatever the c3 certificate does, do not invent a new safety policy). Because est_low(w) grows monotonically as w decreases, admission AT w_low guarantees the bound for all w < w_low — document this monotonicity in the docstring. (5) Self-refuse (return None or raise the named error) on non-finite mu/derivatives or gamma'->1, so near-wall draws refuse by construction rather than returning an optimistic small number. Keep functions <50 lines; separate the value computation (F_P) from the certificate (diffractive_w_low). Module docstring: WHAT/WHY, cite the reduced-shear derivation and F009-S Morse convention.

domain_test_descriptions: LOW-W ANCHOR, BOTH PARITIES (invariant; a future refactor of the carrier limit could silently flip it). Setup: construct a positive-parity Chang-Refsdal geometry (det A > 0, gamma' < 1) and a macro-saddle geometry (det A < 0, gamma' > 1), each with a fixed mu_macro from det A. Operation: evaluate the served low-w amplification at a sequence of decreasing small w (e.g. 1e-2, 3e-3, 1e-3). Expected: for positive parity the value tends to +sqrt(mu_macro) (Morse n=0); for the macro saddle the value tends to -1j*sqrt(mu_macro) (Morse n=1, per F009-S) — NOT 1. Include ONE separate fixture at gamma=kappa=0 where sqrt(mu_macro)=1 and the limit is exactly 1, documenting that F->1 is the degenerate special case only. Diagnostic: plot |F| and arg(F) vs w on a log-w axis; a wrong anchor shows |F| approaching 1 instead of sqrt(mu_macro), or the saddle phase approaching 0 instead of -pi/2.

RUNG P TRUNCATION VS EXACT ENGINE OVER THE CERTIFIED BAND (invariant; the whole rung's legitimacy). Setup: pick a positive-parity geometry safely away from the parity wall (gamma' <= 1 - a few*DELTA_GAMMA_P); compute w_low = diffractive_w_low(...). Operation: on a synthetic grid of w in [w_lo, w_low] compare F_P(w) against the exact reference (the shipped engine / f_schwinger) — a few dozen w points, seconds to run. Expected: max relative error <= CERTIFICATION_BAR (1e-4) across the whole admitted band. This is an ESCALATE-ON-MISS test: if the truncation misses anywhere the certificate admits, the test FAILS (do not encode a widened tolerance). Diagnostic: plot rel_err(w) vs w with a horizontal line at the bar; a violation shows the curve crossing the bar inside [w_lo, w_low].

CERTIFICATE SELF-REFUSAL AND MONOTONICITY NEAR THE PARITY WALL (invariant; guards against a future change letting the saddle series leak into Rung P). Setup: sweep gamma' from well below 1 up toward 1 at fixed other geometry. Operation: call diffractive_w_low / F_P along the sweep. Expected: for gamma' >= 1 - DELTA_GAMMA_P the rung self-refuses (named DiffractiveDomainError or None), never returning a small optimistic number; and w_low decreases monotonically as gamma'->1 (the certified band shrinks to nothing at the wall). Diagnostic: plot w_low vs gamma'; a defect shows w_low staying finite/positive through the wall or a non-monotone spike.

SHEAR-FREE G_PM + EXACT w*ln(w) PHASE CROSS-CHECK (invariant; pins that the w*ln(w) phase stays in C(w) and is never certificate-bounded). Setup: at gamma=kappa=0 (pure point mass, shear-operator series vanishes term-by-term). Operation: evaluate F_P(w) and compare against the direct closed form C(w)*G_PM(w,s) built independently from prefactor_c and point_mass_g_derivatives at several w. Expected: agreement to rtol ~1e-12 (the phase C(w) matches at its documented 1e-14 accuracy); the operator-series contribution is exactly zero at gamma=0. Diagnostic: plot arg-residual vs w; a bounded-phase bug shows a residual that grows like w*ln(w) rather than staying at machine level.

NULL-SPLIT BYTE-IDENTITY (invariant; guards the reconstruction path against silent drift when the diffractive rung does not fire). Setup: choose a draw where w_low <= w_lo (Rung P admits nothing) OR where the diffractive rung is not applicable, so the nested band-split degenerates to the pre-existing single split. Operation: reconstruct the amplification via the new nested-band-split code and via the prior engine-hosted single-split path on the same chart_w. Expected: the two reconstructions are byte-identical (float64) — the extra _band_split_mask call at w_low is a strict no-op when w_low<=w_lo. Diagnostic: assert exact array equality; any diff (even 1 ULP) localizes to the mask/scatter composition.

RUNG S QUADRATURE SELF-CERTIFICATE (invariant; the saddle band-split host's admission criterion). Setup: a macro-saddle geometry at a low w within the hosted band. Operation: evaluate the direct f_schwinger host at quadrature orders N and 2N and take the paired difference; also compare the served value against a higher-order reference. Expected: the N/2N paired error is <= 3e-10 wherever the rung claims to serve (this agreement IS the certificate), and the served value matches the reference to that tolerance. Diagnostic: plot the N/2N error vs w across the saddle band; the hosted region must lie entirely under the 3e-10 line, and W_reach must track min(w_split, ~60) per draw rather than a hard-coded ceiling.

professor_inputs: R1 CORRECTION (load-bearing): the handoff premise 'F->1 as w->0' is wrong; F(w->0)=sqrt(mu_macro)*exp(-i*pi*n/2). Positive parity n=0 -> +sqrt(mu_macro); macro saddle n=1 -> -1j*sqrt(mu_macro) (F009-S). F->1 only at gamma=kappa=0. The FARFIELD_DIFFRACTIVE doc comments carry the same bug and must be fixed.

R1: positive parity has a convergent reduced-shear closed form G_PM = C(w)*1F1(1-iw/2;1;-iws/2) + shear-operator series in (i*gamma'/2w); the w*ln(w) phase is carried EXACTLY in C(w) and must never be bounded by the certificate.

R1 certificate (Rung P): w_low = (gamma'/2)*[sqrt(mu_macro)*R_{M+1}/bar]^(1/(M+1)), bar=CERTIFICATION_BAR=1e-4 (optional SAFETY=20), R_{M+1} = geometry-only operator-tail magnitude from point_mass_g_derivatives; self-refuses as gamma'->1 (reuse DELTA_GAMMA_P). est_low grows as w falls, so admitting at w_low guarantees safety for all w<w_low.

R2 RULING (decisive): TWO rungs, do not unify — the parity wall is a branch point. The macro-saddle shear-operator series DIVERGES and its Fermat-delay moments diverge at every order, so NO analytic low-w series certificate exists for the saddle at any order. Fabricating one (option A) is mathematically impossible; descoping saddle coverage to zero (option C) would under-claim real certified coverage.

R2 Rung S: HOST the saddle band bottom with the cheap exact 1D Schwinger integral f_schwinger directly as a band-split host (option B), self-certifying via paired N/2N quadrature error (tol 3e-10, a first-class certificate); report per-draw upper reachability W_reach=min(w_split,~60) — never hard-code 60. Saddle far-field w_hi maxes ~38 and the 1409 saddle_c3 splits max w_split ~51.6, both < 60, so the band is reachable.

REVIEWER 7b LEDGER RULE: Rung S serves f_schwinger — the exact engine's own quadrature — so under the 7b zero-engine-served bar it is engine hosting with a certificate, NOT an analytic closure of the 12.67% saddle demand. Count the Rung-S route on the engine-hosted side ('diffractive_engine_hosted'); report its coverage as an engine-hosted-with-certificate fraction separate from Rung-P's genuinely-analytic fraction; closure #2 remains chart demand for the campaign, with saddle-bottom charts storing the residual against the exact anchor -1j*sqrt(mu_macro).
